Other maneuvers use the catalog normal. Variants are checked top to bottom against current physiology.

| System | Maneuver | Finding |

| Neuro | Focal neuro exam (CN, strength, sensation)<br>`neuro_focal` | Normal cranial nerves, limb strength, sensation and coordination between attacks. No spontaneous nystagmus at rest. |
| Neuro | Positional testing (Dix–Hallpike)<br>`vestibular_position` | Right Dix–Hallpike elicits a delayed, brief torsional upbeating nystagmus that fatigues. |
| Neuro | Gait<br>`neuro_gait` | Steady unaided between attacks. |

## Teaching points

1. Use the nystagmus pattern during positional testing to select a canalith repositioning maneuver.
2. A typical positional nystagmus pattern supports posterior-canal BPPV. HINTS is not a screening test for brief triggered attacks.
3. Reassess after repositioning; persistent or atypical findings warrant another diagnosis. The game records the maneuver but does not animate nystagmus resolution.
